jobs.title: Market Research Field Interviewer Car Required Part-time
jobs.description:
Job Description

A Day in the Life of an Ipsos Field Market Research Interviewer

Imagine this:

It’s Wednesday afternoon. You’ve had a great day, and now it’s time for your shift as a Field Market Research Interviewer! You’re gearing up for a scheduled 6-hour shift (starting around 1 or 2 PM), one of three you’ve pre-booked for the week, which can include weekdays and weekends between 9 AM and 8 PM.

You hop in your car—don’t forget your business insurance and valid driver’s license! Your mission? Engaging with people right at their doorsteps, gathering their opinions and experiences. You’ll be going door-to-door, inviting them to participate in surveys. But don’t worry; we provide all the training you need to feel confident approaching people, even if they weren’t expecting a visit. Plus, we offer mileage reimbursement for your travels!

With a company-provided tablet in hand, you’ll record their answers—no paperwork required! And the best part? You’re making a real difference! The information you gather helps businesses and organizations make decisions that impact your community.

What Makes Ipsos Special?
  • Diversity and Inclusion: We’re committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. Ipsos has been recognized by The Times as one of the top 50 companies for gender balance in the UK for two consecutive years!
  • Award-Winning Training: We provide exceptional training to set you up for success.
  • Social Responsibility: We’re dedicated to making a positive impact through our BELONG networks, fostering a welcoming environment for everyone.
  • Environmental Commitment: We strive to minimize our environmental footprint and promote sustainability through our ESG principles.

As an Ipsos interviewer, you’ll also enjoy access to:

  • Ipsos More: A fantastic platform offering discounts on everything from clothing and holidays to household goods and everyday shopping essentials. Treat yourself while saving money!
  • Ipsos Wellbeing: A dedicated resource to support your wellbeing, with tips and advice on staying active, eating well, and practicing mindfulness.
This Job Might Be for You If:
  • You love meeting new people and hearing their stories.
  • You’re comfortable striking up conversations and putting people at ease, even in unexpected situations.
  • You’re looking for a part-time gig that lets you choose your hours (at least 12 hours per week in pre-booked 6-hour shifts) and be your own boss.
  • You’re passionate about your community and want to have a voice in shaping its future.

Sound like a good fit? Apply now and join our team of Market Research Interviewers!

jobs.title: Part-Time Teaching Assistant
jobs.description:
Job Description

Join Our Team as a Teaching Assistant!

Salary: Up to £28,437 + excellent benefits

Working Days: Thursday 8:30 AM - 4:30 PM & Friday 8:30 AM - 4:00 PM

Celebrate the Huge Small Victories

At Witherslack Group, our Teaching Assistants thrive on making even the smallest positive changes in the lives of our young people. We believe in celebrating these huge small victories—moments that may seem minor but collectively create a significant impact. Whether it’s a child sitting through a lesson or engaging with peers, every step forward is a reason to celebrate!

Your Role

As a Teaching Assistant, you will:

  • Support children and young people with Autistic Spectrum Disorder and Social, Emotional, and Mental Health needs.
  • Help them learn, develop their abilities, and boost their self-esteem.
  • Be resilient and dedicated, taking pride in the progress you help them achieve.

While the journey can be challenging, the rewards are immense. You’ll receive unwavering support from your colleagues and access to well-resourced school environments, all designed to help you build a fulfilling teaching career.

About Hall Cliffe Primary School

Located in Wakefield, Hall Cliffe Primary is an independent specialist day school dedicated to providing high-quality education for children with a variety of special educational needs and disabilities. Here, you will:

  • Support children who have faced trauma and adversity.
  • Help them feel safe and build trusting relationships.
  • Utilize creative and adaptive teaching methods to foster success.

We are looking for compassionate professionals who can create nurturing environments where children feel valued and ready to learn. This role is not just a job; it’s an opportunity to make a genuine difference in the lives of our students.

What We Offer You

We recognize your hard work and commitment, and in return, we provide:

  • Training: Comprehensive induction and on-the-job training.
  • Holidays: Enjoy full school holidays to recharge.
  • Progression: Opportunities for career development, with many leaders promoted from within.
  • Flexible Benefits: Tailor your benefits, including life insurance options.
  • Wellbeing Support: Access to a range of wellbeing tools and advice.
  • Medical Cover: Claim back costs for appointments like opticians or dentists.
  • Beautiful Work Environments: Work in schools equipped with top-notch facilities.
  • Referral Bonus: Earn £1,000 for every friend you recommend.
  • Pension: Contributory pension scheme matched up to 5%.
Bring Your Whole Self to Work

Our diverse workforce reflects the backgrounds and needs of our young people. You’ll connect with students through:

  • Your positive, can-do attitude as a team player.
  • Your passion for supporting children and making a lasting impact.
  • Your enthusiasm to collaborate with teachers and therapists.
Join Us in Making a Difference

At Witherslack Group, we are committed to inclusion and creating an environment where everyone feels respected and valued. We embrace individuality and champion diversity, especially in neurodiversity. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and are dedicated to making our recruitment process accessible.

By building a diverse and inclusive team, we enhance our ability to support the children and families we serve, ensuring every team member can thrive and be their authentic self.

Note: This position is subject to an enhanced DBS check (cost covered) and an online search. We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer.
